title: Primitive Recursion of the Replicated Encoding
statement: For a Boolean word $s$, let $m(s)$ be the natural number obtained by starting with $1$ and reading the bits of $s$ in reverse order, replacing each current value $v$ by $2v+b$ for the bit $b\in\{0,1\}$. The function sending $s$ to the list of $m(s)$ copies of true is primitive recursive.
hypotheses_covered: The input is a Boolean word
